moment.nsmotionusagedescription.zh-Hans: 在您开始运动后读取本机步数，用于散步、慢跑等运动记录。
moment.nsmotionusagedescription.en: Linko Moment uses motion data to count steps during your exercise sessions.

moment.nscamerausagedescription.zh-Hans: 扫描孩子手表的二维码以填写配对码并确认绑定。
moment.nscamerausagedescription.en: Linko Moment uses the camera to scan watch pairing QR codes.

moment.nslocationwheninuseusagedescripti.zh-Hans: 允许获取位置，用于活动拍照、打卡、查找附近餐厅和记录运动轨迹。您创建或加入好友运动时，持有邀请码并已登录的人可查看这次运动的轨迹。活动位置共享单独开启，离开活动或进入后台时停止。
moment.nslocationwheninuseusagedescripti.en: Allow location access for activity photos, check-ins, nearby dining, and workout routes. When you create or join a shared workout, signed-in people with the invite code can view its route. Activity location sharing is separate and stops when you leave the activity or the app enters the background.

moment.nshealthshareusagedescription.zh-Hans: 读取您授权的心率、活动能量、步数、距离和手表体能训练，用于显示本次运动数据。
moment.nshealthshareusagedescription.en: Read the heart rate, active energy, steps, distance and Watch workouts you authorize to display your exercise data.

moment.nshealthupdateusagedescription.zh-Hans: 将您主动记录的手表运动保存到 Apple 健康，用于在手机和手表查看运动记录。
moment.nshealthupdateusagedescription.en: Save workouts you record on Apple Watch to Apple Health so you can view them on your phone and watch.
